summary: Escape if you can in the darkness with a geometry cube! Spin-off Sqube game
description:
Sqube returns with a new thrilling adventure filled with exciting platformer levels! Time to test your limits!

NOTE: The first 10 levels in the game are free. To unlock the remaining 50 levels, you need to make a purchase.

Squbeworld is in total darkness as the evil dark cubes have sucked the color out of everything. So the black cube must run, jump, hide, and dash to save the colors and restore the Squbeworld. Sqube Escape extends the first game's challenging platformer mechanics with dozens of new enemies, obstacles, and traps. Turn into a cube as one of the best geometry shapes and dash forwards to dangerous worlds.

Good Old Difficulty, New Challenges!
Our good old gd and arcade game mechanics take a new turn in the sequel as there are new enemies, such as the laser-eye and spiked creeper. On top of new enemies, our brutal platformer action is expanded with pendulums, moving steps, and ceiling spikes.

Smooth Gameplay!
We revamped the cube run and block dash mechanics to make the gameplay more fluid and flawless. Thanks to the updates, the cube now jumps more solidly and satisfactorily. The enemy AI is also rewritten for a more fair and challenging platformer experience. Dashing and hiding from them now feels even more organic.

Unlock Powers!
Sqube must save the world from the darkness and protect all spinny squares in this new adventure. Players will save the blue, green, and red cubes and gain new powers along the way. Impossible squares and blocky runs will not stand in your way by unlocking new abilities by completing the chapters. You might even encounter a red ball to gain new platform game skills.

Enhanced Graphics!
Arcade games tend to have stylized graphics, and Sqube Darkness was no exception. With Sqube Escape, we reworked all of the graphic assets to convey the excitement and action of the game in a more immersive way. As a result, the world of Sqube now looks more lively with geometry sprites, animated grass, parallax backgrounds, and robust particle effects.

Features:
- Flexible gameplay with two different control methods: Buttons or swipe.
- Chapter and level progression systems with satisfying rewards.
- Challenging but rewarding gameplay.
- Completely safe to play for any age.
- Atmospheric visuals complement the stealthy gameplay.
- Good training for reflexes and cognitive skills.
- Committed to a long-term update plan ensuring new levels, modes, and challenges.
- Fun for all ages: Good game for family & friends gatherings!
- Simple and highly addictive gameplay.
- Play without the internet.
- Play offline.

Download now and help our blocky dash hero bring the color back to his world!
